name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.239: The auto-sync corrects from 0.7 s instead of 1.0 s — a real half-cue offset is no longer
    left alone, while the measured ~0.5 s offset of an in-sync subtitle still keeps good files untouched.
    A correction that improves the score but cannot prove it is no longer reported as "no proven gain":
    it keeps the original in the reserved block and the run pulls the next candidate instead. Every
    refusal now names its cause and carries the numbers it was decided on.
